issue.title: Obsidian CDP runners inherit a long TMPDIR and abort on SingletonSocket
issue.description: The ownership phase observed all three owned Obsidian launches abort before assertions with Chromium FATAL Socket path too long: <agent-tmp>/scoped_dir.../SingletonSocket. Root cause: Chromium inherits the long SASE TMPDIR, exceeding the AF_UNIX socket path limit. TMPDIR=/tmp/<short> made the same suites launch. Repair the runner launch environment with a short per-run temporary base; retain isolated profile/vault/port/process cleanup. Add a long-TMPDIR regression. Related closed bob-cli-5b fixed only the Python web-clip self-test; do not reopen that completed adapter task. This is bounded runner environment plumbing; small size.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: All three runners fail at startup with the same fatal path error; shortening TMPDIR permits the same commands to execute.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-nh.6.1.1 note 6; deterministic launch failure prevents real acceptance under the SASE agent environment.
